issue: Selected preset button rendered white on white inside the ink sandbox panel (silver surface rule outranked the panel)
fix: Selected segment colour comes from a per surface --fg-inverse token

issue: Bridge diamonds and failed link boxes drawn far from their links (CSS transform-origin applied to the SVG transform attribute)
fix: Pop animation moved to inner elements that carry no transform attribute

issue: Story track edge fade clipped the first letters of the active step ("outers" for "Routers")
fix: Fade moved into a 28px padding outside the slide content

issue: Pinned story taller than the viewport because the heading wrapped in a 7 column cell
fix: Heading spans the full grid; step counter and progress moved into the steps column

issue: Large empty gap above STAR in the topology word list
fix: Word list became a cyclic drum so the selection always has neighbours above and below

issue: Estimator heading left a large empty area top right
fix: Lead paragraph placed beside the heading (columns 8 to 12)

issue: Footer column labels sat 10px above the wordmark centre line
fix: Labels share the wordmark's 40px row

issue: Sandbox lead paragraph touched the definitions hairline (inline margin overrode stack spacing)
fix: Only margin-bottom is reset inline

issue: Estimator value "p = 0.10" wrapped onto two lines
fix: Value output is nowrap

issue: Hero caption squeezed into one tablet column
fix: Caption spans the tablet grid below the CTAs

issue: Mega headline overwhelmed a 390px tall viewport and pushed CTAs below the fold
fix: Display sizes scale with svh on short landscape screens

issue: Load CLS 0.29: headline rewrapped when the display font replaced its fallback
fix: Fallback overrides measured from the real fonts; fonts preloaded on the landing route

issue: Line masks shorter than the display face's content area (about 1.21em in a 0.94em line box)
fix: Mask padding 0.16em top and 0.2em bottom, compensated by negative margins

issue: Segmented control buttons 38px tall on coarse pointers
fix: 40px on coarse pointers

issue: Keyboard focus scrolled the word drum's overflow container, throwing rows out of their slots
fix: Masked containers use overflow: clip; focus uses preventScroll

issue: aria-label on split paragraphs (not allowed on p)
fix: SplitText labels headings only; other splits stay readable in order

issue: axe could not see the silver surface through the clip-pathed wipe layer
fix: Section carries its colour; wipe drawn by transform scaled edge strips

issue: Inactive drum words at 22% opacity (1.2:1) and visible text missing from step and scroll cue names
fix: Inactive words at 50% (3.30:1, large text); accessible names include the visible text

issue: Landing CSS preload not used (credentials mode mismatch warning)
fix: Style preload carries crossorigin like Vite's own request

issue: THREE.Clock deprecation warning from React Three Fiber
fix: Hero rendered with plain three.js from the shared ticker
